titles.title: Where The Spirit Of The Lord Is

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
For we know the truth
Your truth has set us free
In Your Name alone
We have been released

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
You are here with us
You are here with us

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
We are slaves no more
Freedom is our hope
Never looking back
Jesus You are Lord

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
We give all to You
We give all to You

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Where the Spirit of the Lord is there is freedom
Where the Spirit of the Lord is
Chains are broken eyes are open
Christ is with us
Christ is with us

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
Who the Son has freed
He is free indeed
All our sin is gone
We have been redeemed

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
Jesus paid it all
Jesus paid it all

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
Open wide the gates of heaven
Fill our hearts as we surrender
Lord let Your presence fall
Lord let Your presence fall

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
Open wide the gates of heaven
We will worship You forever
Lord let Your presence fall
Lord let Your presence fall
